newsitem.title: USA: Option Care names chief financial officer.
newsitem.headline: Option Care names chief financial officer.

text.p: Option Care Inc, which provides home health care, said Tuesday it named Paul Jurewicz as chief financial officer and senior vice president.
Jurewicz succeeds J. Jeffrey Fox, who will remain with Option Care for a transition period before leaving to pursue other interests.
Prior to joining Option Care, Jurewicz was chief financial officer, exective vice president, and treasurer at Health Management Inc, which provides pharmacy management services.

Option Care also said it appointed James Duncan as president of Option Care Enterprises Inc, a subsidiary that houses its company-owned locations. This is a new position. Duncan was president of Cardiac Alliance Inc, a disease management/home care company.

Option Care acquired 12 home care companies in 1996 and purchased another company in January, 1997. The company recently increased its revolving line of credit to $30 million. The increased credit line will be used for acquisitions.
Option Care provides home health care through a national network of 184 franchised and company-owned locations.
